# Hairline 0.5.1

Source: https://github.com/lucasmarkes/hairline
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lucasmarkes/hairline/v/0.5.1
Author: Lucas Marques. MIT licensed; see LICENSE.

The original vanilla ESM distribution is hosted locally so the Cloud Profiler
thumbnail does not depend on a CDN. Only the source-map URL was removed.
The thumbnail uses the Terrain figure with its built-in autoplay, off-screen
pausing, and reduced-motion support.
